instruction: Recreate the business card as a 2-slide PowerPoint presentation. All elements in the resulting presentation must be editable, except that the QR code in the upper-right corner must be an image. The layout must be identical to that of the original business card.

dim1: The deliverable is in .ppt or .pptx format and opens properly.
The delivered PowerPoint presentation contains exactly 2 slides, and slide 2 contains no Chinese text.
The delivered PowerPoint presentation does not contain any slide that is entirely non-editable.
dim2: +5: Slide 1 contains a group of component shapes or an image within 0%–20% of the left edge and 0%–20% of the top edge of the slide. The overall width of the entire shape group or image is 2-4cm, and its height is 2-4cm. If it is a group of component shapes, it includes an orange-filled circular component, with the remaining components filled green. The orange portion is positioned in the upper-middle area of the overall group.
